conclusion: In this report, we have introduced the GLM-4.5 model series, including GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air. Both models adopt the MoE architecture, which improves the computational efficiency compared to previous GLM models. GLM-4.5 excels at reasoning, coding, and agentic tasks, ranked in 3rd place globally among open-source and proprietary models. We release the model weights of GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air to advance the applications and research of large language models.
